name: Fickle's Pickles
description:
Glass jar containing ten multicolored pickles. When a pickle is consumed, roll 1d10 to determine the effect:

  • 1 - You gain 1d4 Endurance.

  • 2 - You gain +1 temporary Defense for 1 hour.

  • 3 - Your next skill check made within 1 day is favored.

  • 4 - Your next damage roll made within 1 day gets +1d.

  • 5 - All hair on your body turns into dancing flames for 1 hour.

  • 6 - You can hear all sounds made within far range of you as if they were made right next to you for 1 hour.

  • 7 - You emit a bright glow of white light for 1 hour.

  • 8 - You are shrouded in magical darkness for 1 hour. Your outline is visible as a dim glow.

  • 9 - Your height increases by 1 inch, permanently.

  • 10 - Your Speed is doubled for 1 minute.

Each pickle must be consumed in its entirety by one creature within one minute in order for its effects to take hold.
